summary: Fork endpoint: POST /api/shares/[slug]/fork copies snapshot into new session, zeroed accounting
description: New src/app/api/shares/[slug]/fork/route.ts POST: requireUser; load active share (404 if missing/revoked); INSERT sessions row owned by visitor copying voice (grandfathered, NO tier re-check), mode, study_text_id, scope_override=retrieval_scope, forked_from_share_id=share.id, title from original; INSERT queries rows materialized from messages JSONB: query_text/response_text/chunks_used (bare chunk ids extracted from rich snapshot objects), user_id=visitor, accounting ZEROED: input_tokens=0, output_tokens=0, cached_input_tokens=0, cost_usd=0, model_used=NULL, tier_used=NULL (0-token rows are backfill-cost.ts-safe: recompute yields $0; avoids analytics double-count; user_budgets untouched — fork consumes no quota). Returns {sessionId}. Done: tests for zeroed accounting, settings/scope_override copied, revoked-share 404.
